text: Shajee Amjad is introduced as the bastard son of Eddard Stark, raised at Winterfell in the North under the surname given to baseborn children there, alongside the trueborn Stark children Robb, Sansa, Arya, Bran, and Rickon — he was closest to Arya. In truth he was born at the Tower of Joy in Dorne as Aegon Targaryen, son of Rhaegar Targaryen and Lyanna Stark, a secret Eddard Stark kept his whole life. Drawn partly by his uncle Benjen Stark, the Night's Watch's First Ranger who later vanished beyond the Wall, Shajee Amjad joined the Watch at Castle Black, where he was made steward rather than ranger to Lord Commander Jeor Mormont, who later gave him the Valyrian steel sword Longclaw after Shajee Amjad saved his life. He is bonded to the albino direwolf Ghost, into whose mind he can warg. On Qhorin Halfhand's own orders, he killed Qhorin to infiltrate Mance Rayder's wildling host, where he took the spearwife Ygritte as a lover in violation of his vows; she died in his arms during the Battle of Castle Black, which he led in defense of the Wall against Mance Rayder. He refused Stannis Baratheon's offer to legitimize him as a Stark and grant him Winterfell, choosing instead to keep his vows, and was subsequently elected the 998th Lord Commander of the Night's Watch with Samwell Tarly's help. As Lord Commander he sailed to Hardhome, witnessed the Night King raise the dead, and killed a White Walker with Longclaw; he then let the free folk through the Wall, a decision that led his own brothers, under Alliser Thorne, to murder him in a mutiny at Castle Black. The red priestess Melisandre resurrected him. He went on to defeat Ramsay Bolton and retake Winterfell at the Battle of the Bastards, a victory secured by the arrival of the Knights of the Vale, after which the northern lords, led first by Lyanna Mormont, proclaimed him King in the North. He then allied with and became the lover of Daenerys Targaryen, not knowing she was his aunt, before killing her in the throne room after she burned King's Landing despite the city's surrender; for this he was sent back to the Night's Watch rather than executed, and his story ends with him riding north beyond the Wall alongside Tormund Giantsbane's free folk and Ghost. As the trueborn son of Rhaegar Targaryen and Lyanna Stark, he was the rightful heir to the Iron Throne but never claimed it, and his story is shaped throughout by a recurring choice of duty over love. Created by George R. R. Martin, he is a point-of-view character across four novels published between 1996 and 2011.
